entries.note: Which lambda estimator for N ~ 50, T ~ 30: seven estimators (production Knuth bins on raw values; Knuth on normal scores with >= 3 bins; equal-count rank bins; rank bins minus a 200-permutation null; Gaussian copula; KSG k = 4 on normal scores; KSG on raw values) on four toy problems with a known exact lambda (independent 0; Gaussian 0.8; skewed y = (exp(2u) - 1)/2, 0.8; non-monotonic y = x^2 + 0.75 z, 0.825), n = 33, 51, 120 pairs, 500 seeded draws; median and 5-95%. Numbers in figures/data/estimator-toys.json.
